signals.title_orig: OpenAI Introduces Pando: A Git Backend That Cuts Median Push Latency ~80%
signals.summary_orig: OpenAI built Pando, a Git-compatible backend for its monorepo. It handles branches independently, reuses stored packfiles across fetches, cut median push latency by nearly 80%, and now delivers nearly a petabyte of Git data per day. The post OpenAI Introduces Pando: A Git Backend That Cuts Median Push Latency ~80% appeared first on MarkTechPost .
